appearance.pickerFooter: Choose how the app should look. Following the system switches between light and dark when your device does.

language.pickerFooter: Choose the language used throughout the app. Switching to or from a right-to-left language requires a restart.

rtlReloadAlert.title: Restart required
rtlReloadAlert.message: Switching to a {direction, select, rtl {right-to-left} other {left-to-right}} language needs the app to restart so the layout updates.

pace.label: Rowing pace
pace.footer: Rowing convention is per 500 m, regardless of distance units.

section.heartRateFooter: Max heart rate personalizes the 5-zone ramp used by the live HR ribbon and the zone pills. Stored on this device only.
section.bodyFooter: Body metrics personalize the calorie estimate. Everything is stored on this device only.
section.zoneModelFooter: The selected model is used everywhere zones appear: the live HR ribbon, zone pills, and saved activities re-render with this choice.

maxHrBpm.label: Max heart rate
maxHrBpm.pickerFooter: Your highest sustainable heart rate. Defaults to {default} bpm (≈ 220 - 30) when unset.

thresholdHrBpm.label: Threshold heart rate
thresholdHrBpm.pickerFooter: Lactate-threshold HR (LTHR), used for Coggan-style zones. Defaults to ~85% of max HR.

weightKg.label: Weight
weightKg.pickerFooter: Used by the calorie estimate. Defaults to {default, number}{unit} when unset.

ageYears.label: Age
ageYears.pickerFooter: Used by the calorie estimate. Defaults to {default} years when unset.

sex.label: Sex
sex.pickerFooter: Used by the calorie estimate (Keytel formula). Defaults to male when unset.

garminPolar5.label: Garmin/Polar (5 zones)
garminPolar5.subtitle: Standard zones based on % of your max heart rate.

cogganFriel7.label: Coggan/Friel (7 zones)
cogganFriel7.subtitle: Endurance-training zones based on % of your lactate-threshold HR.

profile.footer: Estimates based on HR and body metrics; accuracy improves with an accurate max HR. All values stay on this device.

alert.title: Reset profile?
alert.message: All heart-rate and body values will be cleared. The app will fall back to defaults.

autoStart.label: Auto-start activity
autoStart.subtitle: Start recording automatically when we detect youʼve started rowing.

inactivityReminder.label: Remind me if I forget to stop
inactivityReminder.subtitle: Sends a notification if no strokes are detected for a few minutes while RowerM8 is in the background. Requires notification permission.

showWelcomeSlides.label: Show welcome slides
showWelcomeSlides.subtitle: Welcome slides appear the next time you open the app.

showPlacementInstructions.label: Show placement instructions
showPlacementInstructions.subtitle: Placement instructions appear the next time you connect a device.
